title: Great Tech In Search Of Profits
gist: Gavekal's teaser (paywalled) from its September China Tech Trip says China's tech ecosystem is getting stronger but most firms are squeezed between domestic hyper-competition and geopolitical pressure, limiting profits.

insights.claim: Gavekal's 2026 China Tech Trip found China's tech ecosystem is getting stronger, yet most companies are squeezed between domestic hyper-competition and rising geopolitical pressure.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Technological strength in China does not necessarily translate into investable profits.

insights.claim: The trip covered 19 institutional clients and a dozen site visits across China's semiconductor, AI, new energy, robotics and biotechnology industries.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Scope of the on-the-ground research; details are paywalled.
